name: firstch-tools
description: 35 local MCP tools for web production and development work, from the free browser tools at tools.first-ch.com: WCAG contrast checks, Japanese character / X-weight counting, WebP conversion, JSON-LD, llms.txt and robots.txt generation, Marp slides, encoding and format conversion (JSON/YAML/CSV/Markdown tables), and everyday developer utilities. Runs on your machine via npx; no data is collected or sent.
